channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Delhi court to hear money laundering complaint against Robert Vadra today
item.description: The ED has previously attached multiple properties in India said to be linked to Vadra or entities associated with him, claiming they represent proceeds of crime generated through Bhandari’s offshore dealings.

item.title: Notice issued to DK Shivakumar in National Herald case
item.description: Shivakumar has been directed to appear for an inquiry in Delhi on or before December 19. The police reportedly believe that Shivakumar has key information relevant to this case, and hence the notice has been issued.

item.title: I am Cong MP and went to great trouble to get elected, says Tharoor on possibility of big move amid tensions with party
item.description: In an exclusive conversation with NDTV, during which the Thiruvananthapuram MP was asked if was looking to make a big move anytime soon, Tharoor said, "...I don't know why this has to be asked. I mean I'm an MP of the Congress party. I went to great trouble to get elected. It would take a considerable amount of thought and various other considerations to be anything else."

item.title: Cold wave intensifies in Rajasthan, Fatehpur coldest at 2.3 degrees Celsius
item.description: Icy winds sweeping in from northern India have intensified winter conditions across Rajasthan, causing temperatures to drop sharply and triggering a severe cold wave.

item.title: Kerala High Court gives relief to Cong MLA Mamkootathil from arrest till Dec 15
item.description: In a significant interim relief for beleaguered Congress MLA Rahul Mamkootathil, the Kerala High Court on Saturday directed that he shall not be arrested until December 15, even as the legislator continues to evade police despite mounting pressure from both law enforcement and his own party.

item.title: Yemen govt hands over 26 bodies to Houthis as gesture of ‘goodwill’ ahead of talks
item.description: Yemen's government said it handed over 26 bodies of the Houthi group as a gesture of "goodwill" ahead of the expected resumption of talks sponsored by the United Nations.

item.title: President Trump awarded FIFA Peace Prize at World Cup draw
item.description: The certificate declared FIFA's decision to award the 2025 Peace Prize to Trump "in recognition of his exceptional and extraordinary actions to promote peace and unity around the world, Friday, December 5th, 2025."

item.title: Statewide protests in TN tomorrow over Karthiga Deepam issue
item.description: The Hindu Munnani announced statewide protests across Tamil Nadu on Sunday, alleging religious discrimination and "deliberate obstruction" of Hindu traditions.

item.title: India’s digital public infrastructure bolstering public finance management services: Govt official
item.description: India’s public finance management practices have digital public financial management as its cornerstone, which has enabled substantial fiscal savings, allowing more room for growth-enhancing capital expenditure while maintaining fiscal discipline, according to a senior government official.

item.title: Over 400 IndiGo flights cancelled on 5th day of crisis: Indian Railways steps in to help
item.description: IndiGo cancelled a total of 405 domestic flights as the significant crisis affecting the airline reached its fifth day on Saturday. However, Indian Railways stepped in to help the harassed passengers by adding extra coaches to its trains to accommodate the rush of people.
